entities.name: finn-build
entities.description: Builder skill claiming an approved unblocked Linear issue, prioritizing review feedback, implementing only the issue contract, verifying changes and opening a linked GitHub PR without merging.
entities.capability: Approved Linear issue to pull request workflow

metadata.mutation_scope: Local code/branches, GitHub PRs and Linear state
metadata.concurrency_limit: One builder loop per team; assignment is not an atomic lock between sessions on the same account.

entities.name: finn-review
entities.description: Reviewer skill evaluating a PR against its linked Linear acceptance/non-goal contract and exact head/check results, posting a structured verdict and applying loop or escalation labels while leaving merge authority to a human.

metadata.review_binding: Verdict is bound to the reviewed head SHA; changed heads require a new review.

exclude.reason: Package validation CI is repository maintenance, not another agent workflow.

scoped_review.conclusion: The instruction contracts separate human specification/agent-ready authorization from builder mutations and review evidence. Builder requires a clean tree and warns its issue assignment is not an atomic same-user lock. Reviewer checks current required CI and rechecks head before posting; neither role merges or enables auto-merge. Linear TEAM/labels and host credentials require configuration. Catalog review establishes the workflow and limits; it did not invoke the skills, issue trackers, Git writes or PR comments.

implementation_details: Skill-format validation script and CI
Embedded issue and verdict shapes are parts of their role skills
